Four expressions and every aligned unit reviewed. Preserve repeated converb occurrences, nonnasal hos versus other laughter witnesses, and both aspirated retroflex consonants in land unit kəṭʰṭʰa. Continuous/total-simultaneity commentary remains source-attributed.

Both expressions and every aligned word reviewed. One-ear/two-ear idiom preserves literal component glosses and whole spreading-message translation; elicited versus discourse provenance distinguished explicitly. No target lexical forms in general tail-head theory quotation.

Six complete speech examples and all aligned words reviewed. Preserve literal say-tell, surface kohoḍokḍə versus interlinear kohoḍo-kə, and abe now versus earlier mother. Direct/indirect interpretation stays scoped to source translation, with no person harmonization.
